svg.title: Electrical cost of two generic cooling options
svg.desc: The original three curves show the radiator and fan at high and low speed and the refrigerant circuit. As ambient temperature rises the radiator becomes more expensive, sooner at low vehicle speed; shaded area marks where the cheapest option changes. Qualitative illustrative physics, not measured data.
svg.text: Shaded: speed changes the cheapest option.
↑ Electrical power per unit of heat removed
